name: bun
why: TypeScript runtime, package manager and test runner for this repo

name: just
why: Task runner; every check goes through the justfile
install: `cargo install just`, `brew install just`, or see https://just.systems/man/en/packages.html

name: gitleaks
why: Secret scanning in the pre-commit hook and `just check`; the hook fails without it
install: Install gitleaks 8.30.1 or newer for your platform: `brew install gitleaks`, or download the matching archive from https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases, verify it against the release checksums file, and put the `gitleaks` binary on PATH
